text:
remi_prod: :loudspeaker: Heads-up: Agent v4.0 enforcement timeline for Private/VPC/on-prem. Key changes: mandatory mTLS for agent control plane, stronger cipher suites, and removal of legacy agent protocol. Effective enforcement date: 2026-10-01. Full guidance: https://go.redwood/agent-v4-mtls
sylvia_eng: TL;DR bullets for AEs and engineers so you can copy into customer comms:
sylvia_eng: • Agent v4.0 enforces mTLS (client certs) for all control-plane operations and deprecates plaintext RPC endpoints.
sylvia_eng: • Legacy agents (<= v3.x) will continue to operate in a compatibility mode until 2026-10-01 but will be limited to security-only fixes after 2026-08-15.
sylvia_eng: • Customers must rotate to agent v4.0 to retain full feature parity (hotpatching, automated diagnostics, and policy sync).
anna_sales: One-liner for sales: "Upgrade to Agent v4.0 to keep full support and secure control-plane connectivity; migration assistance available."
mike_support: Support notes:
mike_support: • We'll offer a free 30-day migration assist (remote guidance + verification) for customers who schedule before 2026-09-01.
mike_support: • Paid on-site or extended migration packages available after GA window. Add SKUs: AGENT-MIGRATE-ONB, AGENT-MIGRATE-EXT.
legal_ops: Legal & contract notes: Customers operating in high-control environments may require an exception; route deviation requests to legal_ops@redwood.com. Upgrading to v4.0 requires acceptance of the updated Agent Connectivity Addendum (link in doc).
sylvia_eng: Migration checklist (short):
sylvia_eng: 1) Verify KMS and cert rotation policy.
sylvia_eng: 2) Stage agent v4.0 in a canary group (we recommend <5% traffic).
sylvia_eng: 3) Validate mTLS certs with redwood-ca or bring-your-own CA via SCEP/ACME.
sylvia_eng: 4) Confirm policy-sync and hotpatch endpoints in staging.
ops-bot: Migration task created: TASK/AGENT-V4-4280034321 assigned to mike_support (due 2026-09-15).
docs: Small config snippets for BYO-CA and automatic renewals will be added to the docs tomorrow. Example BYO CA snippet (customer side):
docs: ```
# generate CSR, upload to your CA, install cert
redwoodctl agent enroll --ca-bundle /etc/ssl/my-ca.pem --cert /etc/ssl/agent.crt --key /etc/ssl/agent.key
# check status
redwoodctl agent status --env staging
```
sylvia_eng: Note on compatibility mode: when running legacy agents in compatibility mode, control-plane calls will be proxied with a reduced feature set; telemetry uploads that include sample payloads will be blocked.
mike_support: For air-gapped customers: we'll ship signed agent bundles and a verification tool. Example offline install flow:
mike_support: ```
# on internal host
sha256sum agent-v4.0.tar.gz # verify checksum
redwoodctl agent install ./agent-v4.0.tar.gz --offline --verify-signature ./agent.sig
```
anna_sales: Are there any compliance flags to call out for customers with FIPS HSMs?
sylvia_eng: v4.0 supports FIPS cipher suites and HSM-backed key storage for client certs. Customers that require FIPS validation should enable the fips_compat flag and provide KMS attestation during enroll. Docs will include the exact cipher list.
legal_ops: Important: enforcement timeline -> 2026-08-15 compatibility limited (security-only), 2026-10-01 enforcement. Customers who do not upgrade by enforcement may be placed on a legacy maintenance plan with limited troubleshooting.
docs: Action items: publish BYO-CA guide, offline install guide, and client migration FAQ by EOD next Wed. We'll add an FAQ entry to clarify what "compatibility mode" blocks.
mike_support: Outreach plan: Support will email customers with Private deployments next week with migration windows and scheduling links. We'll prioritize customers on dedicated contracts for earlier outreach.
sylvia_eng: Implementation note: runtime teams will enable a cert-expiry alert in the console two months before a cert rotation is required. We will also add a preflight check in the agent package to warn about legacy protocol usage.
anna_sales: Sales ops: please add AGENT-MIGRATE-ONB to quoting templates and the AE playbook.
ops-bot: Announcement published: <https://go.redwood/agent-v4-mtls|agent-v4-mtls> by @remi_prod at 4280034321
remi_prod: Thanks team. If no objections, we'll publish the customer-facing notice tomorrow and begin scheduling migrations.
legal_ops: No objections. Deviations to legal_ops@redwood.com.
remi_prod: End of thread.
